newsitem.title: UK: London gold fixes barely softer, silver steady.
newsitem.headline: London gold fixes barely softer, silver steady.

text.p: GOLD - Fixes slightly easier at $322.10, down from $322.60 Monday PM and $326.05 AM. Mired near Monday's lows in thin business, seen ranging between $320-$326. SILVER - Unchanged at $4.51/$4.53, seen moving sideways, capped at $4.58/$4.60 resistance. PLATINUM - Touch weaker at $414.50/$417.50, down $2.00. PALLADIUM - Also softer at $201.50/$204.50, off $4.75.
